name: Ham Ninh
kicker: Fishing village on the east shore
summary: East fishing village: walk the pier under the mountain, 20 km northeast of Dương Đông. The bureau puts núi Hàm Ninh at 300 m behind the houses, with clear, gently sloping water in front and Hòn Nghệ to the southeast. The plate is boiled crab with muối tiêu chanh. Morning light at Bãi Vòng is the hour the bureau describes.
heroCaption: The pier at Hàm Ninh, with the village and the mountain across the water
body: Walk the pier, the shore, and the market street. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam places làng chài Hàm Ninh in xã Hàm Ninh, 20 km northeast of thị trấn Dương Đông, under núi Hàm Ninh. That page puts the mountain at 300 m, the water in front clear and gently sloping, Hòn Nghệ to the southeast, and Mũi Ông Đội as the southern point of the island. It names the temporary pier at Bãi Vòng for the morning and the evening light, and pearl fishing as part of the village’s work. The plate is boiled crab, ghẹ luộc, with muối tiêu chanh. The seafood account calls the crabs rosy and speckled, and says the smaller ones carry more flavour.

Núi Chúa, 565 m, is a different summit on the Hàm Ninh range, on the park tour. The village mountain on the village page is the 300 m one. The nature account lists Hàm Ninh with Cửa Cạn and Rạch Tràm as fishing villages you can reach by boat, and it includes the village in the four camping spots. Suối Tranh is about 10 km from Dương Đông on the same road, so the stream and the pier fit one east day.

figures.caption: The market street in Hàm Ninh, with stalls under the umbrellas
figures.alt: Market stalls and umbrellas along the street in Ham Ninh, Phu Quoc

gettingThere: Ride 20 km northeast of Dương Đông to xã Hàm Ninh. The Dương Đông–Hàm Ninh road also passes Suối Tranh at about 10 km. A motorbike, a taxi, or a minibus is the land ride. The nature account also says the village can be reached by boat, with Cửa Cạn and Rạch Tràm.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: 20 km northeast. Stop at Suối Tranh on the way if the stream is the morning and the crab is lunch.

legs.heading: By boat
legs.body: The nature account groups Hàm Ninh with Cửa Cạn and Rạch Tràm as fishing villages reached by boat. The pier at Bãi Vòng is the landing the bureau names for the light.
